subject.title: fix: accept valid MCP tool schemas without strict inputSchema.type check

question: Should bundled MCP discovery rely on the pinned SDK’s private `Client.cacheToolMetadata()` method to preserve output-schema and task metadata while accepting missing root `inputSchema.type` values?
rationale: The branch’s functional repair and regression proof are strong, but choosing to couple production runtime behavior to a private third-party method is an ownership and upgrade-policy decision rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Accept the private seam
options.body: Merge with the existing existence pin and targeted behavior tests, explicitly accepting that SDK upgrades must preserve or replace this metadata-cache call.

options.title: Request a public SDK seam
options.body: Pause this PR until the MCP SDK exposes a supported metadata-cache or custom-list-schema path that can preserve `callTool()` guards without private access.

recommendation.title: Accept the private seam
recommendation.body: Merge with the existing existence pin and targeted behavior tests, explicitly accepting that SDK upgrades must preserve or replace this metadata-cache call.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the current bundled MCP catalog-discovery path most directly.
